context: Write two limericks for moms about how hard it is to get their kids to do chores. Be angry about it. Separate your two limericks with six asterisks (******).

trace.content:
There once was a mom full of rage,
Who screamed at her kids for their age.
"Pick up your socks!" she would shout,
With a furious, angry count,
Until the whole house was a cage!

******

The dishes are piled, the floor is a mess,
The kids just sit there, refusing to dress.
"I'll wash them myself!" Mom declared,
With a voice full of anger and fear,
While the pile of dirty dishes increased!
